record.name: Up Home Loan
record.description: Up Home is a simple loan that works seamlessly with your Up banking. Starting from 10% LVR, it’s first time owner friendly too. Use the Up features you love to own your own home faster.

features.additionalInfo: For fixed rate loans, extra repayments are allowed up to $30,000 in total during the fixed rate period. Extra repayments above this limit may incur a prepayment fee. For variable rate loans, extra repayments are unlimited.
Use your Up spending account and Savers as offsets.
Redraws are limited to the total amount prepaid, less one repayment. Other conditions may apply as per Loan Schedule and Home Loan Booklet.

constraints.additionalInfo: A maximum 90% Loan to Value Ratio applies. A minimum 10% deposit is required.
A minimum borrowable amount for the loan.

fees.name: Visa emergency card/cash overseas fee
fees.additionalInfo: A fee charged when you need an emergency replacement card or cash delivered to you on an urgent basis to an address overseas.

record.name: Basic Home Loan
record.description: The Basic Home Loan offers a low competitive interest rate, an optional One Account to support your everyday banking needs and a redraw facility to manage surplus funds.

tiers.additionalInfo: Borrowing over 60% to 70% of the property value
tiers.name: LVR
